requirements.title: Safe thermal control
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain a safe operating temperature.

requirements.title: Heating interlock
requirements.statement: The controller shall enable heating only when demand is active and the interlock is closed.

requirements.title: Overtemperature response
requirements.statement: The controller shall disable heating when temperature exceeds the configured limit.

requirements.title: Evaluate heating decision
requirements.statement: The software shall evaluate demand and interlock inputs before enabling the heater.

requirements.title: Latch safety shutdown
requirements.statement: The software shall latch heating off after an overtemperature event.
